correctness.rationale: PASS. The object is the ordinary matching complex of the labeled Pappus cubic graph with LCF [5,7,-7,7,-7,-5]^3, not an independence complex or a perfect-matching subcomplex. Reconstructed the 27 graph edges and all 35,368 matchings including the empty one. Independent exhaustive F2 boundary elimination gave augmented ranks (1,26,271,1448,4195,6362,4335,984,42) and only reduced mod-2 Betti 40 in degree 5, bounding rational homology there; the signed Euler characteristic agrees. Reconstructed all 216 graph automorphisms by adjacency-preserving bijections, independently evaluated the fixed matching-orbit Lefschetz formula on every automorphism, and reproduced eleven vertex/edge cycle profiles and character distribution (-4:18,-2:36,-1:36,0:81,1:12,4:32,40:1). The original verifier also implements independent direct signed simplex traces. The character sum is zero and rational invariants, hence positive-degree rational homology of the finite orbit quotient, vanish. This is a complete finite exact character, not a homotopy classification of the quotient.
